gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the GardePro E5 2.0, ChatGPT's budget pick, needs GardePro's MB300 security box. GardePro says the MB200 box, which fits the original E5 and E5S, does not fit it.
standout_why: I read the cited Cam & Canopy best non-cellular page and TrailCamSetup, the #1 organic result. Cam & Canopy covers battery count, SD limits for some models and 12V jacks, and names only one accessory pairing (the GardePro A60 with the SP350 panel). It never mentions security boxes and does not cover the E5 2.0. TrailCamSetup states no accessory, power-jack or SD limits for any camera. The cited Digital Camera World Core S-4K review came back truncated, so I could not check it. An SD-only camera has to be visited in person and is left out alone in the field, so protecting it from theft matters. Neither rival page I could read gives the generation-specific box pairing.
decides: This confirms the E5 2.0 as the budget pick. It also adds one buying rule: E5 2.0 owners must get the MB300 box ($31.20 at gardepro.com), not the MB200 sold for the E5 and E5S. The generation suffix decides which box fits. GardePro's own store also lists the E5 2.0 at $63.99, below the $79.99 ChatGPT showed.
